description: Returns the issue trackers connected to a team (Jira, Linear) and what each of them can do: search for tasks, list iterations (sprints, cycles), write estimates back. Call this first — the other poker tools depend on what is connected. An empty list means tasks can only be added manually with poker.game.tasks.add.

team_id.description: Team to inspect. Required when more than one team is available — call retro.teams.list first.
